key: We'll handle the situation. Stay back if you have no immediate business in the ward.
en: We'll handle the situation. Stay back if you have no immediate business in the ward.
ja: 状況はこちらで対処します。このワードに急ぎの用がなければ、下がっていてください。

key: No other bombs have been found. Please remain calm.
en: No other bombs have been found. Please remain calm.
ja: 他に爆弾は見つかっていません。落ち着いてください。

key: Nothing to see here; move along.
en: Nothing to see here; move along.
ja: ここには見るものはありません。移動してください。

key: I don't know, but judging by the landing of the rubble, it seems most likely that the bomb was placed underneath the Stairway.
en: I don't know, but judging by the landing of the rubble, it seems most likely that the bomb was placed underneath the Stairway.
ja: 分からないけど、がれきの落ち方から見て、爆弾は大階段の下に仕掛けられてたっぽいね。

key: Underneath? I always assumed it was totally solid.
en: Underneath? I always assumed it was totally solid.
ja: 下に? てっきり全部詰まってるものだと思ってたよ。

key: They opened! The Grand Gates, sealed for years, have finally opened!
en: They opened! The Grand Gates, sealed for years, have finally opened!
ja: 開いた! 何年も封鎖されてた大門が、ついに開いた!

key: Wondering what this marvel is? Kids these days, don't know a thing.
en: Wondering what this marvel is? Kids these days, don't know a thing.
ja: この驚異が何か気になるかい? 最近の子は、何にも知らないんだから。

key: These here are the Grand Gates to Reborn City! They used to be the main passage between the city and the Aventurine Region!
en: These here are the Grand Gates to Reborn City! They used to be the main passage between the city and the Aventurine Region!
ja: これが、リボーンシティの大門さ! 昔は、この街とアベンチュリン地方をつなぐ、主要な通路だったんだよ!

key: But massive as they are, they haven't opened in years.
en: But massive as they are, they haven't opened in years.
ja: でも、こんなに巨大なのに、もう何年も開いてなかったんだ。

key: Closed.
en: Closed.
ja: 閉まっている。

key: "Open from 8PM to 4AM"
en: "Open from 8PM to 4AM"
ja: 「営業時間: 午後8時~午前4時」

key: An advertisement is plastered on the wall...
en: An advertisement is plastered on the wall...
ja: 壁に広告が貼られている……

key: "The amazing Agate Circus!
en: "The amazing Agate Circus!
ja: 「驚異のアゲートサーカス!

key: Featuring carnies, clowns and chaos!
en: Featuring carnies, clowns and chaos!
ja: 見世物師にピエロ、そして大混乱!

key: Now with the famed Agate Ace Triumvirate!
en: Now with the famed Agate Ace Triumvirate!
ja: 今なら、あの名高きアゲートエーストリオも登場!

key: Take the challenge and face off against three Reborn League Leaders in a spectacular showcase smack- down!
en: Take the challenge and face off against three Reborn League Leaders in a spectacular showcase smack- down!
ja: リボーンリーグの3人のリーダーに挑み、豪快なショーダウンで対決しよう!

key: Just west of Agate City!
en: Just west of Agate City!
ja: アゲートシティのすぐ西!」

key: Welcome to the Reborn Nightclub! --ACE MEMBERS ONLY--
en: Welcome to the Reborn Nightclub! --ACE MEMBERS ONLY--
ja: リボーンナイトクラブへようこそ! ――エースメンバー限定――

key: On this day, humanity received a grim reminder...
en: On this day, humanity received a grim reminder...
ja: この日、人類は厳しい教訓を突きつけられた……

key: I heard a huge noise come from up ahead! What happened?
en: I heard a huge noise come from up ahead! What happened?
ja: 前の方からすごい音が聞こえたんだけど! 何があったの?

key: I'm just relieved that no one was hurt.
en: I'm just relieved that no one was hurt.
ja: 誰も怪我しなかったのが、せめてもの救いだよ。

key: Strange attack, in that sense.
en: Strange attack, in that sense.
ja: その意味では、奇妙な攻撃だったな。

key: Now I can evolve my Machoke!
en: Now I can evolve my Machoke!
ja: これでゴーリキーを進化させられる!

key: W-why would anyone do something like this?!
en: W-why would anyone do something like this?!
ja: ど、どうしてこんなことするの!?

key: OFFICER: Hey, no entry for civilians.
en: OFFICER: Hey, no entry for civilians.
ja: 警官: おい、一般人は立ち入り禁止だ。

key: Until we've deemed the area safe, you'll have to back off.
en: Until we've deemed the area safe, you'll have to back off.
ja: 安全が確認できるまで、下がっていてもらう。

key: Even if the Grand Stairway is a mess, it's not like anyone could get out of the city anyway.
en: Even if the Grand Stairway is a mess, it's not like anyone could get out of the city anyway.
ja: 大階段がめちゃくちゃになったところで、どうせ誰も街から出られないんだしな。

key: The Grand Gates haven't opened for years.
en: The Grand Gates haven't opened for years.
ja: 大門は何年も開いてないんだから。

key: Damage report complete! It seems peripheral structures were only damaged minimally.
en: Damage report complete! It seems peripheral structures were only damaged minimally.
ja: 被害報告完了! 周辺構造物への被害は、最小限だったようです。

key: So this wasn't an accident. Good to know.
en: So this wasn't an accident. Good to know.
ja: つまり事故じゃなかったってわけか。分かってよかった。

key: Yeah. The blast-type was a fairly controlled radius. It's usually used for municipal demolition.
en: Yeah. The blast-type was a fairly controlled radius.  It's usually used for municipal demolition.
ja: ああ。爆発のタイプからして、かなり制御された範囲だ。通常、都市の解体作業で使われるやつだな。

key: The Stairway looks terrible...
en: The Stairway looks terrible...
ja: 大階段、ひどい有様だな……

key: I mean, even worse than it was before it was blown up.
en: I mean, even worse than it was before it was blown up.
ja: というか、爆破される前よりひどいくらいだ。

key: Such gorgeous, pristine water flowing in from the Carnelian Mountains.
en: Such gorgeous, pristine water flowing in from the Carnelian Mountains.
ja: カーネリアン山脈から流れ込む、こんなに美しく澄んだ水。

key: This waterfall feeds the Azurine Lake, which means all this water is going to be contaminated.
en: This waterfall feeds the Azurine Lake, which means all this water is going to be contaminated.
ja: この滝はアズリン湖に注いでいるから、この水も全部汚染されることになるんだろうな。

key: Welcome, come one, come all for the grand unveiling of Silph Co.'s most fabulous new product!
en: Welcome, come one, come all for the grand unveiling of Silph Co.'s most fabulous new product!
ja: さあさあ、いらっしゃい! シルフカンパニー最新にして最高の新製品、盛大なお披露目会だよ!

key: It's the best thing since indoor bread!
en: It's the best thing since indoor bread!
ja: 屋内パン以来の大発明だ!

key: The most convenient thing since sliced plumbing!
en: The most convenient thing since sliced plumbing!
ja: スライス済み配管以来の便利さだよ!

key: Ladies and gentlemen, may I present to you-- the "Link Stone"!
en: Ladies and gentlemen, may I present to you-- the "Link Stone"!
ja: 紳士淑女の皆様、ご紹介しましょう――「リンクストーン」です!

key: Are you tired of having to find potentially untrustworthy Trainers to trade your Pokémon with to evolve them?
en: Are you tired of having to find potentially untrustworthy Trainers to trade your Pokémon with to evolve them?
ja: ポケモンを進化させるために、信用できるかも分からないトレーナーを探して交換するの、もううんざりじゃないですか?

key: Are you as heartbroken as your Pokémon is when it has to be traded away from you just to grow?
en: Are you as heartbroken as your Pokémon is when it has to be traded away from you just to grow?
ja: 成長させるためだけに手放さなきゃいけなくて、ポケモンと同じくらい胸を痛めていませんか?

key: Your worries are over!
en: Your worries are over!
ja: もう心配ご無用!

key: The Link Stone can force a Pokémon to evolve while never leaving your care!
en: The Link Stone can force a Pokémon to evolve while never leaving your care!
ja: リンクストーンなら、あなたの手元から離すことなく、ポケモンを強制的に進化させられます!

key: The remarkable scientists of Silph Co. have produced this marvelous new Stone,
en: The remarkable scientists of Silph Co. have produced this marvelous new Stone,
ja: シルフカンパニーの優秀な科学者たちが、この驚異の新しい石を作り出しました、

key: Infused with the very energy emitted in a real trade that causes Pokémon to evolve!
en: Infused with the very energy emitted in a real trade that causes Pokémon to evolve!
ja: 実際の交換の際にポケモンを進化させる、あのエネルギーそのものが込められているのです!

key: This Link Stone will be hitting stores soon, but you all are a lucky bunch.
en: This Link Stone will be hitting stores soon, but you all are a lucky bunch.
ja: このリンクストーン、近日中に店頭に並びますが、皆さんは幸運です。

key: Right here, right now, you can get a prototype edition fully-functional Link Stone for just $10,000!
en: Right here, right now, you can get a prototype edition fully-functional Link Stone for just $10,000!
ja: 今ここで、完全に機能する試作版のリンクストーンを、たったの1万ドルで手に入れられるんです!

key: \GBe the first to try it! What do you say?!
en: \GBe the first to try it! What do you say?!
ja: \G一番乗りで試してみませんか!? どうです!?

key: There you go! One happy customer!
en: There you go! One happy customer!
ja: はい、どうぞ! お客様、一名様ご満足!

key: I'm afraid you can't afford this! Anyone else?
en: I'm afraid you can't afford this! Anyone else?
ja: あなたには、少々お手頃じゃないようですね! 他にいらっしゃいますか?

key: Suit yourself. Who wants to try it? Don't be shy!
en: Suit yourself. Who wants to try it? Don't be shy!
ja: お好きにどうぞ。誰か試してみたい人は? 遠慮なさらずに!

key: Look for the Link Stone at the Obsidia Department Store soon!
en: Look for the Link Stone at the Obsidia Department Store soon!
ja: リンクストーンは、近日オブシディアデパートにて発売予定です!

key: FERN: Man, these bitch-ass cops won't even let us through.
en: FERN: Man, these bitch-ass cops won't even let us through.
ja: ファーン: ったく、このクソ警官ども、通してすらくれねえのかよ。

key: Yeah, there was a terrorist threat. I get it.
en: Yeah, there was a terrorist threat. I get it.
ja: ああ、テロの脅威があったのは分かるさ。

key: But they should be accepting help from the people to deal with it.
en: But they should be accepting help from the people to deal with it.
ja: でも、対処するのに市民の助けを受け入れるべきだろ。

key: If they could do it on their own, this wouldn't have happened in the first place.
en: If they could do it on their own, this wouldn't have happened in the first place.
ja: 自分たちだけでどうにかできるなら、そもそもこんなことにはなってねえはずだ。

key: They're too tripped up on their own power and policies to even see that.
en: They're too tripped up on their own power and policies to even see that.
ja: 自分たちの権力や方針にこだわりすぎて、それにすら気づいてねえんだよ。

key: That right there is why the bad guys keep getting away--
en: That right there is why the bad guys keep getting away--
ja: だからこそ、悪党どもが逃げ続けられるんだ――

key: Because no one on our side has the backbone to stop them.
en: Because no one on our side has the backbone to stop them.
ja: こっち側に、あいつらを止める根性のある奴が誰もいねえからな。

key: I guess they're not ready for people of my caliber.
en: I guess they're not ready for people of my caliber.
ja: オレほどの器の人間には、まだ対応できねえってわけか。

key: There's another gym in the Lapis Ward, so I'm gonna get ready to bust it in.
en: There's another gym in the Lapis Ward, so I'm gonna get ready to bust it in.
ja: ラピスワードに別のジムがあるから、そこをたたき潰す準備でもするか。

key: Later, loser.
en: Later, loser.
ja: じゃあな、負け犬。

key: Introducing!
en: Introducing!
ja: 紹介しよう!

key: Presenting!
en: Presenting!
ja: お披露目だ!

key: This is pretty cool...
en: This is pretty cool...
ja: これ、結構かっこいいな……

key: CAIN: There you are!
en: CAIN: There you are!
ja: カイン: いたいた!

key: As soon as I distract this guy, make a break for it!
en: As soon as I distract this guy, make a break for it!
ja: オレがこいつの気を引いたら、すぐに逃げ出すんだ!

key: I don't know how long I'll be able to keep his attention.
en: I don't know how long I'll be able to keep his attention.
ja: どれくらい注意を引きつけていられるか分からねえからな。

key: You ready?
en: You ready?
ja: 準備はいいか?

key: CAIN: Right on.
en: CAIN: Right on.
ja: カイン: よし来た。

key: CAIN: Man, he's not even that cute.
en: CAIN: Man, he's not even that cute.
ja: カイン: ったく、そんなにかわいい顔でもねえのにな。

key: Well, whatever. Maybe it'll make this work better.
en: Well, whatever. Maybe it'll make this work better.
ja: ま、いいわ。かえってやりやすいかもな。

key: CAIN: Hello, excuse me?
en: CAIN: Hello, excuse me?
ja: カイン: こんにちは、すみません?

key: OFFICER: Not right now, son, we're busy.
en: OFFICER: Not right now, son, we're busy.
ja: 警官: 今は無理だ、坊主、忙しいんだ。

key: CAIN: I-- I'm sorry, but I need to report a crime.
en: CAIN: I-- I'm sorry, but I need to report a crime.
ja: カイン: あ――すみません、犯罪の通報をしたいんですけど。

key: OFFICER: What-- with all this happening?
en: OFFICER: What-- with all this happening?
ja: 警官: 何だって――こんな状況で?

key: What kinda crime is it?
en: What kinda crime is it?
ja: どんな犯罪だ?

key: CAIN: I, uh...
en: CAIN: I, uh...
ja: カイン: その、あの……

key: I was struck.
en: I was struck.
ja: 打たれたんです。

key: OFFICER: Who did this to you? When?
en: OFFICER: Who did this to you? When?
ja: 警官: 誰にやられたんだ? いつだ?

key: CAIN: ...Should I really say here?
en: CAIN: ...Should I really say here?
ja: カイン: ……本当にここで言っていいのかな。

key: Someone might be watching...
en: Someone might be watching...
ja: 誰か見てるかもしれないし……

key: OFFICER: ...Well, I can't leave this post.
en: OFFICER: ...Well, I can't leave this post.
ja: 警官: ……まあ、持ち場は離れられないが。

key: Here, step aside with me.
en: Here, step aside with me.
ja: ほら、こっちに来て話せ。

key: OFFICER: Why don't you tell me exactly what happened, son?
en: OFFICER: Why don't you tell me exactly what happened, son?
ja: 警官: 何があったのか、正確に話してくれないか、坊主?

key: CAIN: Well, like I said, I was struck...
en: CAIN: Well, like I said, I was struck...
ja: カイン: ええと、言った通り、打たれたんです……

key: ...By your stunning good looks~
en: ...By your stunning good looks~
ja: ……あなたの見事な男前っぷりに~

key: OFFICER: I... beg your pardon?
en: OFFICER: I... beg your pardon?
ja: 警官: な……何だって?

key: CAIN: Okay, gotta make sure we're set.
en: CAIN: Okay, gotta make sure we're set.
ja: カイン: よし、準備万端か確認しないとな。

key: I'll wait until you finally say 'yes' to me~
en: I'll wait until you finally say 'yes' to me~
ja: あなたが「はい」って言ってくれるまで、待ってますよ~

key: Oh! I think I'll get one of these for my Kadabra!
en: Oh! I think I'll get one of these for my Kadabra!
ja: あ! これ、うちのユンゲラーに買ってあげようかな!
1万ドル!? うわあ!

key: Technology these days...
en: Technology these days...
ja: 最近の技術はすごいなあ……

key: CAIN: Sorry, sorry!
en: CAIN: Sorry, sorry!
ja: カイン: ごめんごめん!

key: It was just a joke, haha~
en: It was just a joke, haha~
ja: ただの冗談ですよ、はは~

key: The truth is, I'm a bit lost.
en: The truth is, I'm a bit lost.
ja: 実は、ちょっと道に迷っちゃって。

key: OFFICER: Lost? You ain't from around here?
en: OFFICER: Lost? You ain't from around here?
ja: 警官: 迷った? この辺の人間じゃないのか?

key: CAIN: Oh, no, I grew up not too far outside the city.
en: CAIN: Oh, no, I grew up not too far outside the city.
ja: カイン: あ、いや、街の少し外で育ったんです。

key: But I couldn't help but be lost in your eyes~
en: But I couldn't help but be lost in your eyes~
ja: でも、あなたの瞳に迷い込まずにはいられなくて~

key: OFFICER: Son, if you don't have a real crime to report, I'm gonna have to ask you to leave.
en: OFFICER: Son, if you don't have a real crime to report, I'm gonna have to ask you to leave.
ja: 警官: 坊主、本当の通報でないなら、立ち去ってもらうしかないな。

key: CAIN: Okay, sorry-- I've been dancing around it because I'm nervous.
en: CAIN: Okay, sorry-- I've been dancing around it because I'm nervous.
ja: カイン: すみません――緊張しちゃって、遠回しになってました。

key: The truth is,
en: The truth is,
ja: 実を言うと、

key: It's a crime how attractive you are~
en: It's a crime how attractive you are~
ja: あなたの魅力的すぎるところが、罪なくらいで~

key: OFFICER: Son.
en: OFFICER: Son.
ja: 警官: 坊主。

key: OFFICER: I'm gonna have to ask you to head on home.
en: OFFICER: I'm gonna have to ask you to head on home.
ja: 警官: もう家に帰ってもらうしかないな。

key: CAIN: Oh, that's okay.
en: CAIN: Oh, that's okay.
ja: カイン: あ、それは大丈夫です。

key: Because I can't help but feel that my home is in your arms~
en: Because I can't help but feel that my home is in your arms~
ja: だって、あなたの腕の中こそが、オレの帰る場所って気がしてならないので~

key: OFFICER: What exactly are you trying to do here?
en: OFFICER: What exactly are you trying to do here?
ja: 警官: 一体お前、ここで何をしようとしてるんだ?

key: CAIN: What I'm trying to do?
en: CAIN: What I'm trying to do?
ja: カイン: 何をしようとしてるかって?

key: You~
en: You~
ja: あなたを~

key: Isn't that obvious?
en: Isn't that obvious?
ja: 分かりきってるじゃないですか?

key: OFFICER: I'm gonna have to write you up.
en: OFFICER: I'm gonna have to write you up.
ja: 警官: これは、報告書を書かないといかんな。

key: CAIN: Oooh, breaking out the handcuffs, are we?
en: CAIN: Oooh, breaking out the handcuffs, are we?
ja: カイン: おおっ、手錠を出すつもりですか?

key: OFFICER: Son, you know I can classify this as sexual harrassment, right?
en: OFFICER: Son, you know I can classify this as sexual harrassment, right?
ja: 警官: 坊主、これはセクハラとして処理できるんだぞ、分かってるか?

key: CAIN: Okay, okay!
en: CAIN: Okay, okay!
ja: カイン: はいはい、分かりました!

key: Joke's over; I don't wanna make you feel uncomfortable for real, sir.
en: Joke's over; I don't wanna make you feel uncomfortable for real, sir.
ja: 冗談はここまでです。本当に不快にさせるつもりはなかったんで。

key: Truth is, my friend put me up to this as a dare.
en: Truth is, my friend put me up to this as a dare.
ja: 実は、友達に度胸試しでやらされたんですよ。

key: OFFICER: Uh huh.
en: OFFICER: Uh huh.
ja: 警官: ふーん。

key: I'm gonna need you to stick around while I take down your information.
en: I'm gonna need you to stick around while I take down your information.
ja: お前の情報を控える間、ここに留まってもらうぞ。

key: OFFICER: Cain LaRue...
en: OFFICER: Cain LaRue...
ja: 警官: カイン・ラルー……

key: And what's your home address?
en: And what's your home address?
ja: 住所は?

key: I don't have one.
en: I don't have one.
ja: ないんです。

key: No joke, officer.
en: No joke, officer.
ja: 冗談抜きで、警官さん。

key: OFFICER: ...Oh boy, this is gonna be complicated.
en: OFFICER: ...Oh boy, this is gonna be complicated.
ja: 警官: ……やれやれ、これは面倒なことになりそうだ。

key: Link Stone? Sounds silly!
en: Link Stone? Sounds silly!
ja: リンクストーン? バカげてる!

key: VICTORIA: Battle me.
en: VICTORIA: Battle me.
ja: ヴィクトリア: わたしと戦ってください。

key: VICTORIA: And here we are again.
en: VICTORIA: And here we are again.
ja: ヴィクトリア: また、ここに戻ってきました。

key: When I face this way, and look out over the lake,
en: When I face this way, and look out over the lake,
ja: こちらを向いて、湖を見渡すと、

key: I can see the academy from here.
en: I can see the academy from here.
ja: ここからアカデミーが見えます。

key: That's my home.
en: That's my home.
ja: あそこがわたしの家です。

key: It's like nothing's changed.
en: It's like nothing's changed.
ja: まるで何も変わっていないみたい。

key: And then just behind me, a bomb site.
en: And then just behind me, a bomb site.
ja: でも、すぐ後ろには爆破現場。

key: Surreal.
en: Surreal.
ja: 現実離れしています。

key: And what have I done?
en: And what have I done?
ja: それで、わたしは何をしたでしょうか。

key: I teamed up with you to stop Team Meteor before and was immediately captured like some useless damsel.
en: I teamed up with you to stop Team Meteor before and was immediately captured like some useless damsel.
ja: 前にあなたと組んでチームメテオを止めようとしたのに、役立たずのお姫様みたいに、あっさり捕まってしまいました。

key: I don't accept that.
en: I don't accept that.
ja: それを受け入れるわけにはいきません。

key: \PN, you have my heartfelt gratitude for giving me a chance to break free.
en: \PN, you have my heartfelt gratitude for giving me a chance to break free.
ja: \PN、逃げ出す機会をくれたこと、心から感謝しています。

key: Battle me.
en: Battle me.
ja: わたしと戦ってください。

key: I need to learn and grow much stronger if I'm ever going to make a real difference here.
en: I need to learn and grow much stronger if I'm ever going to make a real difference here.

en: VICTORIA: I can't say I'm not a little disappointed that I don't measure up better,

en: You may be easy in battle, but you're easier on the eyes.

en: VICTORIA: Yeah, I don't think so.

en: Can't imagine you get too much attention over that giant forehead of yours.

en: VICTORIA: If you keep talking, you're gonna regret it.

en: FERN: He's kinda been my wingman once or twice, but that's it.

en: FERN: She's kinda been my wingman once or twice, but that's it.
ja: ファーン: 一、二回ウィングマンやってもらったことがあるだけだ、それだけだぜ。

en: FERN: They've kinda been my wingman once or twice, but that's it.
ja: ファーン: 一、二回ウィングマンやってもらったことがあるだけだ、それだけだぜ。

en: VICTORIA: Oh, so you won't really mind if I knock his lights out.

en: If even people like Shelly can be Gym Leaders, no wonder the Flobot got in.

en: I think we're past due, and this girl isn't worth my time.

en: VICTORIA: ...

en: Sure, go ahead!

en: Here, let me heal your team first.

key: FERN: As if you can!
en: FERN: As if you can!

key: ...Noob.
en: ...Noob.

en: VICTORIA: Hah!
ja: ヴィクトリア: はっ!

en: But go off, I guess.
ja: まあ、勝手に言ってろよ。

en: Whatever helps you sleep at night.
ja: 夜安眠できるならどうぞってな。

en: Paltry tricks and pot-shots are only gonna get you so far in the League.
ja: つまらない小細工や当てずっぽうじゃ、リーグではそう長く続かねえぞ。

key: When you zero out and have to spend your time hanging out with bottom-feeders like her, I'll be looking down from the Champion's seat.
en: When you zero out and have to spend your time hanging out with bottom-feeders like her, I'll be looking down from the Champion's seat.

key: Smell you later, losers!
en: Smell you later, losers!

en: VICTORIA: Yeah, I bet you're just going to turn tail and run after saying all that stuff!

en: You don't have either the integrity or the spine to stick around after saying it!

en: VICTORIA: I'm sorry about all that.

en: If I had known someone like him was going to come along, I would never have held you up here...

en: As I was GOING to say before--
ja: さっき言おうとしていたことだけど――

en: I wanted to thank you for your time and energy by giving you this.
ja: あなたの時間と労力に感謝して、これを渡したかったの。

key: VICTORIA: ...But maybe it's more of an apology by now.
en: VICTORIA: ...But maybe it's more of an apology by now.
ja: ヴィクトリア: …でも今となっては、おわびの方が近いかもしれないわね。

en: You'll need Shelly's Gym Badge to use that outside of battle though.
ja: それを戦闘の外で使うには、シェリーのジムバッジが必要だけど。

en: ...Truthfully I'm a little worried about her based on what that guy said.

en: She was crying?
ja: 泣いていたの?

en: I'm going to go clean up, and then I think I'll drop by to check on her, just in case.

key: VICTORIA: My forehead isn't even that big, geez...
en: VICTORIA: My forehead isn't even that big, geez...

en: VICTORIA: Then gather your strength, and come back when you're ready.

en: We only get stronger by facing adversity with our full spirit.

en: Suddenly more commotion here. Wonderful.
ja: また急に騒がしくなってきたわね。結構なことだこと。

en: Bonjour, my friend! Let us do battle!

en: Ah, mercy, mercy!

en: You are as strong as you are alluring.
ja: 強さも魅力も、素晴らしいものだ。

en: Tell me, do you consider yourself powerful?

key: Power is not a simple victory.
en: Power is not a simple victory.

en: A victory is meaningless if the battle changes nothing.

en: What's this?

en: ADRIENN: No, I mean, where--

key: ADRIENN: I don't--
en: ADRIENN: I don't--
ja: アドリエンヌ: わたし――

en: ADRIENN: Um...
ja: アドリエンヌ: あの…

en: RADOMUS: Are you quite all right?

en: ADRIENN: I'm confused.

en: CAIN: Uh, Reborn City?

en: Haven't you been here before?
ja: 来たことなかったっけ?

key: ADRIENN: This isn't the city.
en: ADRIENN: This isn't the city.
ja: アドリエンヌ: これは街じゃないわ。

key: This isn't... Reborn.
en: This isn't... Reborn.
ja: これは…リボーンじゃない。

key: ADRIENN: I thought that was--
en: ADRIENN: I thought that was--

key: ADRIENN: Where is the center?
en: ADRIENN: Where is the center?

key: Where are the cabins and the port and the--
en: Where are the cabins and the port and the--
ja: 小屋も、港も、それに――

key: ADRIENN: The lake...
en: ADRIENN: The lake...
ja: アドリエンヌ: 湖が…

key: It's... brown?
en: It's... brown?
ja: 茶色に…?

key: CAIN: You must be new here.
en: CAIN: You must be new here.
ja: カイン: 来たばっかりなんだね、きっと。

key: ADRIENN: I'm not!
en: ADRIENN: I'm not!
ja: アドリエンヌ: 違うわ!

en: I've lived in Reborn City my whole life!

key: But not-- this isn't the Reborn City that I know!
en: But not-- this isn't the Reborn City that I know!

key: This place is disgusting...

key: Nothing like the quiet city I grew up in.
en: Nothing like the quiet city I grew up in.
ja: わたしが育った静かな街とはまるで違う。

en: GARDEVOIR: I think someone's gone a little Looney-tone~
ja: サーナイト: どなたか、少々おかしくなってしまったようですわね~

en: RADOMUS: On the contrary, I have a somewhat different theory.
ja: ラドマス: いや、私は少し違う考えを持っているよ。

key: Adrienn, the last time you saw this city, the lake was more properly colored.
en: Adrienn, the last time you saw this city, the lake was more properly colored.
ja: アドリエンヌ、君が最後にこの街を見た時、湖はもっと正しい色をしていたはずだ。

key: Is that right?
en: Is that right?
ja: そうだね?

key: ADRIENN: Yes. It was a perfect, brilliant blue.
en: ADRIENN: Yes. It was a perfect, brilliant blue.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ええ。完璧な、輝くような青だったわ。

key: That's why we named it Azurine.
en: That's why we named it Azurine.
ja: だからアズリンと名付けたのよ。

key: RADOMUS: Tell me what else you remember.
en: RADOMUS: Tell me what else you remember.
ja: ラドマス: 他に覚えていることを聞かせてくれ。

key: ADRIENN: Let's see... It used to be very lush.
en: ADRIENN: Let's see... It used to be very lush.
ja: アドリエンヌ: そうね…昔はとても緑豊かだったわ。

key: There were trees all over the place.
en: There were trees all over the place.
ja: どこにでも木が生えていた。

key: This waterfall, the Celestinine Cascade, poured down into a river that ran through the city.
en: This waterfall, the Celestinine Cascade, poured down into a river that ran through the city.
ja: この滝、セレスティナイン滝は、街を流れる川へと注いでいたの。

key: At the corner of the lake, there's a beautiful little port, and my Gym--
en: At the corner of the lake, there's a beautiful little port, and my Gym--
ja: 湖の隅には小さくて美しい港があって、それにわたしのジムが――

key: What about my Gym?
en: What about my Gym?

key: I've got to go there!
en: I've got to go there!
ja: そこに行かなくちゃ!

key: RADOMUS: I believe it would not be best to leave xem alone right now.
en: RADOMUS: I believe it would not be best to leave xem alone right now.
ja: ラドマス: 今、この方をひとりにするのは良くないと思う。

en: CAIN: Xe said that xyr Gym was at a port...

key: Wait, xe's a Gym Leader?!
en: Wait, xe's a Gym Leader?!

key: GARDEVOIR: Ah, ah, ah~ You finally figured it out!
en: GARDEVOIR: Ah, ah, ah~ You finally figured it out!

key: Of course ~I~ knew all along.
en: Of course ~I~ knew all along.
ja: もちろん~わたくし~はずっと前から知っておりましたけれど。

key: There was a stand-in for a time, but...
en: There was a stand-in for a time, but...

key: Well, it seems xe'll be taking xyr position back now!
en: Well, it seems xe'll be taking xyr position back now!
ja: どうやら、この方が立場を取り戻すことになりそうですわね!

key: CAIN: Then, xe must mean the Coral Ward Gym!
en: CAIN: Then, xe must mean the Coral Ward Gym!
ja: カイン: じゃあ、コーラルワードのジムのことだ!

key: RADOMUS: Indeed. Let's go.
en: RADOMUS: Indeed. Let's go.
ja: ラドマス: その通りだ。行こう。

key: Shall we head there together?
en: Shall we head there together?
ja: 一緒に向かおうか?

key: New around here?
en: New around here?
ja: こっちは初めてか?

key: Do you know about this place? Reborn's Nightclub.
en: Do you know about this place? Reborn's Nightclub.
ja: ここがどんな場所か知ってるか? リボーンのナイトクラブだ。

key: It's just a little gig I run for some of the region's top brass.
en: It's just a little gig I run for some of the region's top brass.
ja: 地域のお偉方向けに、ちょっとしたショーをやらせてもらってるだけさ。

key: To tell you the truth, city regulations make it a little more exclusive than I'd like.
en: To tell you the truth, city regulations make it a little more exclusive than I'd like.
ja: 正直言うと、市の規則のせいで、俺が望むよりも排他的になっちまってる。

key: If it were up to me, people could come and go.
en: If it were up to me, people could come and go.
ja: 俺次第なら、誰でも自由に出入りできるようにするんだけどな。

key: But for those already in the inner circle, inclusivity's a straight loss.
en: But for those already in the inner circle, inclusivity's a straight loss.
ja: だが、すでに内輪にいる連中にとっちゃ、間口を広げるのは単なる損ってわけだ。

key: Maybe someday we can change that.
en: Maybe someday we can change that.
ja: いつか変えられるかもな。

key: For now, the best way to get invited would be to do something special, like take down the whole League, or join it.
en: For now, the best way to get invited would be to do something special, like take down the whole League, or join it.
ja: 今のところ、招待される一番の方法は、何か特別なことをすることだ。リーグを丸ごと倒すとか、加入するとかな。

key: If it were up to me, you'd already be welcome.
en: If it were up to me, you'd already be welcome.
ja: 俺次第なら、もうとっくに歓迎してるところなんだけどな。

key: But them's the breaks.
en: But them's the breaks.
ja: でもまあ、そういうもんだ。

key: My break's about over; was just enjoying the air for the moment.
en: My break's about over; was just enjoying the air for the moment.
ja: 休憩もそろそろ終わりだ。ちょっと外の空気を楽しんでただけさ。

key: Gotta get back to the tracks.
en: Gotta get back to the tracks.
ja: トラックに戻らねぇとな。

key: DJ Arclight, at your service.
en: DJ Arclight, at your service.
ja: DJアークライト、ご用命はお気軽に。

key: Remember the name.
en: Remember the name.
ja: この名前、覚えとけよ。

key: Peace.
en: Peace.
ja: それじゃあな。

key: I don't get it. Someone blew up the Grand Stairway?
en: I don't get it. Someone blew up the Grand Stairway?
ja: わけがわからん。誰かが大階段を爆破しただと?

key: Geez. Half of North Obsidia was already destroyed in the earthquakes. Now this?
en: Geez. Half of North Obsidia was already destroyed in the earthquakes. Now this?
ja: まったく。北オブシディアの半分はもう地震でやられてたってのに。今度はこれか?

key: People these days are really awful.
en: People these days are really awful.
ja: 最近の連中は本当にひどいもんだ。

key: Hello, Trainer! Battle me!
en: Hello, Trainer! Battle me!
ja: やあ、トレーナー! 俺と勝負しろ!

key: What? How!?
en: What? How!?
ja: アケミ: え? どうして!?

key: You definitely cheated!
en: You definitely cheated!
ja: 絶対イカサマしたでしょ!

key: MAGMA: Yooo, back off, Aqua scum! I just paid for a super rare prize and let me tell you, I am steamed!
en: MAGMA: Yooo, back off, Aqua scum! I just paid for a super rare prize and let me tell you, I am steamed!
ja: マグマ: おいこら、下がれよ、アクアのクズが! 超レアな景品に大金払ったばっかりだってのに、マジでムカついてんだよ!

key: Dammit, I'm losing everything!
en: Dammit, I'm losing everything!
ja: バンソン: くそ、全部負けちまう!

key: MAGMA: Gaaah!
en: MAGMA: Gaaah!
ja: マグマ: ぐああっ!

key: Why do you all ruin everything?! I didn't even have time to see what the super rare Pokémon was before one of your kind carried it off!
en: Why do you all ruin everything?! I didn't even have time to see what the super rare Pokémon was before one of your kind carried it off!
ja: なんでお前らは何でもかんでも台無しにするんだ?! 超レアなポケモンが何だったかも見る間もなく、お前らの仲間に持っていかれたんだぞ!

key: Leave me be, before I sock you all in the guts!
en: Leave me be, before I sock you all in the guts!
ja: 腹にパンチ食らわせる前に、俺に構うな!

key: MAGMA: Bro! What's up! I'm steamed!
en: MAGMA: Bro! What's up! I'm steamed!
ja: マグマ: おい! 聞いてくれよ! マジでムカついてる!

key: I bought this super rare Pokémon off this kid in Central Obsidia, but then an Aqua Gang member saddled up and made off with it!
en: I bought this super rare Pokémon off this kid in Central Obsidia, but then an Aqua Gang member saddled up and made off with it!
ja: 中央オブシディアでガキから超レアなポケモンを買ったんだけど、アクアギャングの奴が乗り込んできて持ち逃げしやがったんだ!

key: Gosh, I want to go over there and just pound 'em all, but I know the boss doesn't like starting skirmishes without reason.
en: Gosh, I want to go over there and just pound 'em all, but I know the boss doesn't like starting skirmishes without reason.
ja: ったく、あそこに乗り込んで全員ぶちのめしてやりたいけど、ボスは理由もなくもめ事を起こすのを嫌うからな。

key: Hey, if you're gonna go get it from 'em, use this!
en: Hey, if you're gonna go get it from 'em, use this!
ja: なあ、もし取り返しに行くなら、これを使えよ!

key: Call it an extra punch from your pal!
en: Call it an extra punch from your pal!
ja: 仲間からの追加の一発だと思ってくれ!

key: MAGMA: I bought this super rare Pokémon off this kid in Central Obsidia, but then an Aqua Gang member saddled up and made off with it!
en: MAGMA: I bought this super rare Pokémon off this kid in Central Obsidia, but then an Aqua Gang member saddled up and made off with it!
ja: マグマ: 中央オブシディアでガキから超レアなポケモンを買ったんだけど、アクアギャングの奴が乗り込んできて持ち逃げしやがったんだ!

key: <- Castelia Street\nv - 9th Street
en: <- Castelia Street\nv - 9th Street
ja: <- セキタイ通り\nv - 9番街

key: Spare some change?
en: Spare some change?
ja: 小銭恵んでくれない?

key: ...That's fine.
en: ...That's fine.
ja: ウォルドン: …いいさ。

key: You know, not many people come down this way anymore.\nThat's great-- most of them won't care if I'm asleep here!
en: You know, not many people come down this way anymore.\nThat's great-- most of them won't care if I'm asleep here!
ja: 最近じゃ、こっちの方に来る人もあんまりいないんだよな。\n最高だよ――ほとんどの奴は俺がここで寝てても気にしないからな!

key: <>- Castelia Street\nv - 8th Street
en: <>- Castelia Street\nv - 8th Street
ja: <>- セキタイ通り\nv - 8番街
